items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: O'Neal Lavishay, well he was a violin player, I worked with him at a few clothes, it's been a little while.

ctx.x: What about O'Neal Lavishay? Did you ever know him?

O'Neal Lavishay, well he was a violin player, I worked with him at a few clothes, it's been a little while. He died. He was a violin player. He worked for, he was, he worked for the post office too, he's a mail carrier. And he played violin, he played over at a few clothes, had a fella called a few clothes, had a nightclub just like Billy Phelps and all of them, right across from 25. 25's on this corner, right across from 25's. It was a little hall, he'd go through alley and go in the back, sort of a hall back…
You know, I never didn't understand about a few clothes that was built, would anybody come in from Basin Street?
